subject: LangBridge plugin compatibility & minimal sandbox plan
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan@lightchain.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick sync: Lightchain LangBridge plugin compatibility

Hey Evelyn / Kimberly / Soojin —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lightchain Labs has been building a small collection of LangChain-style plugins that surface our retrieval+vector tooling to downstream runtimes. We heard from a couple beta customers that Redwood is a target runtime they want to run against for production (lower latency + batch routing).

We'd like to run a short compatibility pass against Redwood's hosted API + a minimal dedicated sandbox so we can: 
- confirm our plugin load/manifest expectations,
- validate token/stream behavior for function-like calls, and
- exercise embedding/metadata roundtrips.

Proposed lightweight plan: a 3-day sandbox with a small test harness, a compatibility matrix (attached), and a short runbook for onboarding (we can host the harness). Can Redwood stand up a temporary sandbox (VPC or dedicated reserved pool) or give us a hosted test key with increased quotas for 72 hours?

Attachments: compat-matrix.xlsx (compatibility checklist)

If useful, Anya (cc'd on subsequent emails) will follow with more details on the plugin manifests.

Happy to adapt — what would you need from us to kick this off?

—Ethan
Lightchain Labs

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan@lightchain.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: Lightchain LangBridge plugin compatibility

Thanks Ethan — this is actionable. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide a scoped dedicated sandbox for 72 hours; we can also issue a hosted test key with temporary quota increases but with fewer networking controls.

Quick asks from our side so we scope correctly:
- target traffic profile (qps, average prompt length)
- which plugin capabilities you need exercised (tool calling, streaming partial results, embeddings)
- any data residency/CSR requirements for the sandbox

Kimberly, can your team own the sandbox provisioning and attach basic observability (token-level cost traces + latency histogram)? Soojin, can you take point on the compatibility matrix once Ethan/Anya confirm fields?

I can provision a 72-hour dedicated instance (routed to us-west) if we have the manifest and the expected QPS. We prefer Lightchain to host the harness and push sample manifests and a smoke-test script.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Ethan Cole <ethan@lightchain.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: Lightchain LangBridge plugin compatibility

Ethan — good to meet you here. I’ll take sandbox provisioning. Plan and constraints: 

1) Environment: 72-hour dedicated sandbox in us-west with a single GPU pool (2x A100 equiv.) and elevated quotas. No production traffic, isolated logs.
2) Observability: we’ll enable a short retention trace capture and token-level cost breakdown to share metrics post-run.
3) Networking: if you need callbacks from the sandbox to your plugin endpoints, we can whitelist IPs or accept webhook verification (mutual TLS recommended).

Deliverables from Lightchain to get started:
- plugin manifest tarball (manifest.json + examples)
- a small smoke-test harness that hits /generate and /embeddings endpoints
- target QPS and typical prompt size (tokens)

I attached a quick compatibility checklist (compat-matrix.xlsx) with columns we typically look at. We'll also produce a sandbox-runbook.md for onboarding and troubleshooting.

Next steps: Ethan/Anya send the manifest + harness. I’ll trigger provisioning and send a sandbox access token with start/end windows. Tentatively aiming to start Thursday morning (US-PDT).

—Kimberly
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: compat-matrix.xlsx

From: Ethan Cole <ethan@lightchain.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Anya Markov <anya@lightchain.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync: Lightchain LangBridge plugin compatibility

Perfect — thanks Kimberly and Evelyn. We attached the manifest tar (manifest-v1.tar.gz) and a minimal harness (smoke-test.sh) plus a mapping doc. Quick answers: target QPS: 5 sustained, 15 burst; avg prompt 120 tokens; we need function-like tool-calls and streaming. No special residency needs for this test.

We saw the compat checklist and will fill it out (Anya will own). We prefer start Friday 09:00 PDT if that works on your side. Also: we included a Drive folder with sample responses and a short Postman collection.

Attachments: manifest-v1.tar.gz, smoke-test.sh

Looking forward — Ethan
Lightchain Labs
